findings.issue: 'RB Leipzig – Borussia Mönchengladbach' wraps mid-word with no hyphen: 'Mönchengladbac' on one line and a lone 'h' on the next. Not truncated/hidden info, just an unpolished hard break on a long word at this column width.

notes: Match names read in full at all three widths once zoomed in - long titles wrap onto 2-3 lines rather than truncate (e.g. 'Husqvarna British Masters hosted by Sir Nick Faldo', 'Union Berlin – Eintracht Frankfurt'); no hidden info.

Every event row shows a channel and every one seen is Norwegian: Viaplay, TV 2 Play, VG+ Sport, HBO Max (Sport), NRK, Discovery+, YouTube (Saint Louis Chess Club), BLAST Premier (Twitch) - no ESPN/FOX/Sky.

Cross-checked the same fixture in two places on the page (DIREKTE NÅ live-now list vs. the agenda row) for 'Brighton – Tromsø' and 'Brann – PAOK': channel labels matched exactly both places (Viaplay and VG+ Sport respectively) - no contradiction, despite looking that way in a lower-resolution first pass.

The golf meta line 'Reitan ut 18:06' under TOUR Championship is by-design (dashboard.js golfTeeHint: surname + next Norwegian tee time), not a data glitch - confirmed by reading the code comment and the event's norwegianPlayers data.
Team crests/flags render as distinct small logos at all three widths, no broken-image icons.
Single quiet column, day-grouped agenda ('I DAG', 'I MORGEN', 'LØRDAG 29. AUGUST', ...), generous spacing, not cluttered.
375px width: no horizontal overflow (confirmed via scrollWidth vs clientWidth in-page, not just visually), no clipped right-edge chevrons/info icons.

Bottom of the page (375px): footer ('Oppdatert for 5 min siden', 'Abonner i kalender', 'AI-budsjett'), 'Dette dekker vi'/'Merker og kilder' disclosures and the floating Assistent button all sit clear of one another - the button does not occlude the last agenda content or the footer.
900px width: the floating Assistent button sits in the empty margin beside the 640px column - correct, not a finding (DESIGN.md-sanctioned).
Must-see accent dots appear sparingly (a handful of rows per day), not on every row.
Header, day headings, and footer intact and aligned at all three widths.
